relations.subject: Madeleine Biardeau
relations.evidence: She was educated at the Ecole normale supérieure in Sèvres, where she studied philosophy.

relations.subject: Madeleine Biardeau
relations.evidence: Biardeau joined the University of Travancore for two years in the 1950s, and studied Sanskrit texts with pandits.

relations.subject: Madeleine Biardeau
relations.evidence: Meanwhile, she also taught at the École pratique des hautes études.

relations.subject: Madeleine Biardeau
relations.evidence: She translated the Ramayana of Valmiki into French (1991), in collaboration with two other scholars: Marie-Claude Porcher and Philippe Benoit.
